patch_description: This version keeps the original pipeline structure (detrend → noise estimate → RTS smoother → bidirectional one-pole damper) but improves the damper stage per feedback: lower alpha floor to 0.40 with a lag/correlation guard, and apply two cascaded bilateral passes at moderate alpha (0.65) instead of one strong pass. The zero-phase (forward-backward) filtering means lower alpha adds no phase delay; smoothing ripple (which caps the slope-change score) can therefore be reduced without lag penalty. The guard correlates damper output against the pre-damper RTS output; if correlation drops below 0.97 the alpha is backed off toward 0.85 to preserve tracking accuracy and prevent over-smoothing of genuine dynamics. Cascading two moderate passes flattens the effective group-delay/frequency response near the dominant frequencies of the test signals relative to a single steep pass, improving false-reversal behavior while keeping lag low. All inputs/outputs are unchanged.
